correctness.rationale: Retrieved the actual rank-assignment convention: 90 permutations of multiset (0,0,1,1,2,2), each associated with eight ordinary six-cell permutations. Reconstructed all 4005 pairwise minimum LCS distances, independently obtaining histogram d=1:1080, d=2:1440, d=3:1440, d=4:45; an independent LIS correspondence checks LCS on permutations. Compatibility edges mean distance≥3. Complete bitset clique enumeration gives no six-clique and exactly 72 five-cliques (maximum 5); their ten pair-distances all equal three. Independently checking the 15 perfect matchings and their six partitions into five one-factors proves each maximum yields a K6 1-factorization, with exactly 12 optima over each. The S6 orbit of one maximum contains all 72, hence stabilizer 720/72=10. Scope limited to this finite metric convention.
